mu-01.front: What does the first number in an MU (Management Unit) number tell you?
mu-01.back: The region. MU 3-27 is Region 3, unit 27 (99%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03).

mu-02.back: Vancouver Island (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03).

mu-03.back: Lower Mainland. Mission is here (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03).

mu-04.back: Thompson. Heffley Creek and Kamloops are here (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03).

mu-05.back: Kootenay (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03).

mu-06.back: Cariboo (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03).

mu-07.back: Skeena (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03).

mu-08.back: 7A Omineca, 7B Peace. Both use 7 in their MU numbers (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03 and the synopsis).

mu-09.back: Okanagan. Oliver, Osoyoos, Penticton and Kelowna are here (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03).

mu-10.front: How many hunting regions does BC (British Columbia) have?
mu-10.back: 9: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7A, 7B and 8 (99%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03).

mu-11.back: MU 3-27, Region 3 Thompson. Sun Peaks is in it too (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03 and BC Geographical Names).

mu-13.back: MU 3-20, just south of 3-27 (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03 and BC Geographical Names).

mu-14.back: MU 2-8, Region 2 Lower Mainland (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03 and BC Geographical Names).

mu-15.front: Abbotsford and Chilliwack, south of the Fraser, are in which MU?
mu-15.back: MU 2-4 (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03 and BC Geographical Names).

mu-16.front: Oliver and Osoyoos are in which MU?
mu-16.back: MU 8-1, Region 8 Okanagan. The South Okanagan quail country (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03 and BC Geographical Names).

mu-17.back: 8-2, 8-8, 8-9 and 8-12 (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03).

mu-18.front: Penticton and Kelowna are in which MUs?
mu-18.back: Penticton MU 8-9, Kelowna MU 8-10 (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03 and BC Geographical Names).

mu-19.front: Why check the MU before every hunt?
mu-19.back: Seasons and limits are set by MU in the synopsis tables. Read your exact MU row in the Rule Book (95%, synopsis season tables).

mu-20.front: Close MU numbers, like 3-27 and 3-29: neighbours?
mu-20.back: Not always. 3-27 does not touch 3-29. Check the map (95%, BC MU map layer, data date 2026-10-03).
